Audience: every first-time Nevada Basic Class C applicant, with extra weight for applicants under twenty-one who face a lower alcohol limit.
Why it matters to a first-timer: the per se limits, the refusal rule and the under-twenty-one limit are exact legal values [A01], and the license-loss list shows that a lost license never returns automatically [A04].
Level: high-volume recall of limits, revocation periods, jail ranges and fine ranges by offense, with several confusable pairs; low conceptual load but heavy number load.
Prerequisites: sec11 for SR-22 and the demerit point system, which the penalty and license-loss rules refer to.
